judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a planning artifact (`.lore/dod.md`), a single failing acceptance test file (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), and three spec lines, without writing any production implementation code at all. Consequently, all tests in the candidate diff fail because `src/types/messages.ts`, `validation.ts`, `messageHandler.ts`, `createServer.ts`, and `config.ts` are completely untouched. Furthermore, the candidate's plan and tests directly contradict the issue requirements in multiple places: it uses `list_sessions`/`session_list` instead of `list_conversations`/`conversation_list`, omits the `transport.history` opt-in config and `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`, and asserts that a store without `listFor` returns an empty list (`sessions: []`) when the issue explicitly requires returning an `UNSUPPORTED` error.
